verdict.rationale: Anytype's own docs say content stays in an encrypted Vault on the user's device and that 'not even Anytype can see your content.' Local-only and self-host modes can also remove Anytype's servers entirely. Together these structurally keep the vendor from accessing data that could be used for training, but no evidence explicitly addresses AI training. missing for 10: an explicit no-AI-training policy or opt-out statement, coverage of third-party/AI-integration data use, independent verification of the no-access claim.
